geometry_semantics.metric_regular: A metric-regular Archimedean truncated octahedron has six square and eight regular-hexagonal faces. The exact BCC Voronoi fixture below is one realization, fixed up to Euclidean similarity and orientation inside the declared lattice construction.
geometry_semantics.affine_combinatorial: An invertible affine image retains the face lattice and translational tiling but generally loses square and regular-hexagonal metric data and is not asserted to remain a Euclidean Voronoi cell.
geometry_semantics.extracted_statistical: A Reading-H extraction must freeze its center rule, thresholds, tie breaking, boundary convention, and defect policy before any Voronoi/Delaunay face statistic is evaluated.
geometry_semantics.firewall: Metric-regular, affine-combinatorial, and extracted-statistical meanings are different candidate classes and may not be switched after seeing energy or stability data.

standard_bcc_voronoi_fixture.cell: P={x in R^3: |x_i|<=2 and sigma dot x<=3 for every sigma in {+1,-1}^3}
standard_bcc_voronoi_fixture.voronoi_proof: The 14 displayed inequalities are the bisectors for the six vectors +/-4e_i and eight vectors 2sigma. For every other v=2n in L, parity gives 2 sum_i |n_i|<=sum_i n_i^2; the box inequalities imply x dot v<=|v|^2/2. Hence P=Vor_L(0).
standard_bcc_voronoi_fixture.faces: six square faces with four vertices and eight regular-hexagonal faces with six vertices

affine_realization_family.tiling: D_t P tiles R^3 by translations D_t L because an invertible affine map preserves the original face-to-face translational partition.
affine_realization_family.invariant: The descendants of the six quadrilateral facets have opposite-cell translation lengths {4t,4,4/t}; their maximum/minimum ratio is t^2.
affine_realization_family.consequence: Distinct t>1 give pairwise nonsimilar noncubic affine-combinatorial realizations. Therefore truncated-octahedron combinatorics alone cannot have a finite exhaustive realization list.
affine_realization_family.boundary: D_t P is not claimed to be the Euclidean Voronoi cell of D_t L. Nonlattice, multimotif, nonmonohedral, and statistically extracted realizations are not classified.
